messages:
alex_marketing: Noticed a spike this morningabout 12 leads that stayed unassigned after MQL. Most have UTMs. We lost followups for a webinar batch.

revops_lee: Hmm. Can you share a couple HS ids? I'm worried the enrichment step is blocking assignment again.

alex_marketing: Sure: HS-11012, HS-11045, HS-11067. Workflow history shows 'enrichment queued' then nothing.

ops_jess: Looking at the workflow code now. We recently made enrichment synchronous in main branch; that means if the third-party API slows, assignment waits. Bad call in hindsight.

sam_sales: That's the same bug we hit last quarter. We should never block owner assignment on enrichment. Always assign first, then enrich async and push a task to verify if data changes.

emily_cs: Agree. For PQLs (product-qualified) we might keep enrich before assignment but for standard MQLs we should not block.

revops_lee: Proposed changes:
- Turn enrichment into async job triggered post-assign
- Update round-robin to skip users in /vacation calendar (use on-call list)
- Add fallback: if async job fails twice -> route to revops-review queue
- SLA: owner set in HS within 3 minutes of MQL (enterprise leads 10m)

alex_marketing: Can you also make the HS->SF sync set OwnerId immediately when HS owner is assigned? That was causing 'Lead: Owner blank' in Salesforce.

ops_jess: Yes. Current sync runs every 5 minutes and only copies owner if present. I'll change it to push OwnerId on assignment via API.

hs_sync_bot: Reminder: Workflow 'MQL Pipeline v4' deployment scheduled in 15 minutes by ops_jess.

sam_sales: For the round-robin, let's add a small token bucket to ensure users don't get >3 leads in 10 minutes. Prevent flooding AEs.

revops_lee: Good idea. Also, telemetry: add metric 'mql_unassigned_rate' and 'mql_owner_assign_latency_ms'. We should set an alert if unassigned_rate > 2% for 1h.

emily_cs: And create a standard SF task template "Verify enrichment data" that auto-attaches to leads routed to revops-review. 24h due date.

ops_jess: Action list:
- ops_jess: flip enrichment to async + immediate assign, bump sync to API push (ETA: 2026-03-22 EOD)
- revops_lee: update round-robin logic + token bucket (ETA: 2026-03-23)
- sam_sales: confirm SF OwnerId mapping and token limits (ETA: 2026-03-22 morning)
- emily_cs: create SF task template and checklist (ETA: 2026-03-22)
- alex_marketing: provide sample CSV of affected leads and webinar runbook impacts (uploaded to #marketing-files)

alex_marketing: Uploaded samples and a list of missed followups. Thanks all :rocket:

revops_lee: I'll monitor the new deployment. If after 24h unassigned_rate > 2% we run a postmortem.

hs_sync_bot: Workflow 'MQL Pipeline v4' edited by ops_jess at 2026-03-22T16:05:00Z
